name: artifactory
description: JFrog Artifactory: search artifacts, read their details, browse repository paths.

settings.name: ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN
settings.label: Access token
settings.help: JFrog → your profile → Generate an Identity Token (or an access token from an admin)

guidance: Search by file name with * wildcards, e.g. `app-*.apk`; narrow to a repository when you know it.
Paths are relative to a repository: `com/example/app/1.2.0/app-1.2.0.jar`.

functions.name: ping
functions.description: Check the connection: the repositories the token can see.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Find artifacts by file name (wildcards allowed).

functions.name: artifact_info
functions.description: An artifact's size, checksums, dates and download URL.

functions.name: list_path
functions.description: List a folder in a repository.
